services.name: Let's go fishing.
services.desc: Need some help with your casting or maybe want to perfect the double haul? Maybe you have a particular fly pattern or fly tying technique that is giving you fits. Let us help you! Our experienced instructors are available by the hour for private instruction on just about any subject related to fly fishing. Private One-Day Schools availalbe for groups of 1 or more anglers and equipment can be provided! If you're new to fly fishing and want to learn the basics of fly casting or if you're an experienced veteran looking for feedback and tips to perfect your technique, we are here to help with 1-on-1 fly casting lessons. blurb: Ohio Fly Fishing Guides offers guided fly fishing experiences on local waters targeting inland stream trout, steelhead trout, muskie, northern pike, smallmouth, carp, and more. They have a team of licensed guides with combined experience to provide fly fishing adventures for all skill levels. Private lessons are available by the hour for instruction on various fly fishing subjects.
